title: An edit during playback stops playback first
manual: Uses main's test hook test_dispatch (play, and escape as a status probe), enabled by "testCommands": true. The background instance plays audio for about a second. If playback does not start in a background instance the 'playing: true' check fails; test_core.py treats that case as a note.

steps.note: let the instance's audio finish loading

questions: Settled 2026-10-29 (core-v1): the runner stops playback before every write, after the request passes its checks; the write does not report it.
